findings.title: Dual password update not atomic
findings.description: Supabase Auth and users table are updated in separate operations. If the second fails, Auth has the new password but the table still has the old hash. Wrap in a transaction or add compensating rollback logic.

findings.title: No test coverage
findings.description: The change-password API route and settings/password page have no automated tests. Add tests for: current password verification, new password validation, demo account blocking, unauthenticated access, Auth/table sync failure scenarios.

findings.title: Password validation duplicated
findings.description: The same regex patterns (/[A-Z]/, /\d/) and length check (8 characters) exist in both the UI (page.tsx) and API (route.ts). Extract to a shared validation utility to ensure consistency.

findings.title: Error message leaks database structure
findings.description: The API returns 'User not found in database' when the users table query fails. This reveals that password hashes are stored separately from Supabase Auth. Use a generic message like 'Failed to verify current password'.
